source_text: 公交车曾是中国人出行的主要交通工具。近年来，由于私家车数量不断增多，城市的交通 问题越来越严重。许多城市为了鼓励更多人乘坐公交车出行，一直在努力改善公交车的服务 质量。车辆的设施不断更新，车速也有了显著提高。然而，公交车的票价却依然相当低廉。 现在，在大多数城市，许多当地老年市民都可以免费乘坐公交车。
reference_translation: Buses used to be the main means of transportation for Chinese people. In recent years, due to the continuous increase in the number of private cars, urban traffic problems have become increasingly serious. To encourage more people to take buses, many cities have been making efforts to improve the service quality of buses. The facilities of the buses are constantly being updated, and the speed has also been significantly improved. However, the bus fares remain quite low. Now, in most cities, many local elderly citizens can take buses for free.
